subject: Agent 02 focus decision: topology-fenced bounded FoldInteractive fallback, not dynamic all-panel anchors
body: Discovery inventory complete against main 413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. Physical peer trace confirms current single DEFAULT_DISPLAY FoldInteractive token has telemetry blind windows, but repository history confirms dynamic all-display anchor churn was previously reverted after correlating with cover-panel black flashes.
